margin-leverage: Two runs finish one cycle: the sweep is too long for one 15-minute run, so each run saves progress and the next resumes.
earnings-call-sentiment: Two runs finish one cycle: the sweep is too long for one 15-minute run, so each run saves progress and the next resumes.
quality-financials: Makes no API calls: reads the annual reports margin-leverage already saved.
quality-score: Second stage of the Quality Score page. Needs quality-financials first.
sentiment: The VIX input (INDEX_DATA) is not available on this Alpha Vantage plan, so the implied-volatility factor cannot be filled.
putcall: No page of its own: feeds the Sentiment Index through the sentiment job.
shareholder-yield: Buyback yield is read from the share-count-trends data, not fetched again.
dividend-growth: Only companies with three or more full years of dividends are included.
post-earnings-drift: Uses the earnings-surprise data, which is a manual snapshot.
beeswarm-meta: Company names and sectors reused by about 20 other jobs.
quality-lowvol: Needs margin-leverage and relative-strength to have run first.
surprise: Manual snapshot; post-earnings-drift depends on it.
